editorial: Ever wonder what you would do if you woke up alone in space with no memory? You get to follow a science teacher as he tries to save the sun from burning out. The way he uses basic science to solve huge problems is super satisfying to watch. You will love this if you like smart stories that still feel like a fun ride.
endingExplained: Grace finds a way to stop the sun from dying and sends the cure back to Earth. He decides to stay behind to help an alien friend save their own planet instead of going home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves space adventures and smart heroes.
